verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
In the crushing
In the pressing
You are making
New wine

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
In the soil, I
Now surrender
You are breaking
New ground

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
So I yield to You
and to Your careful hand
When I trust You
I don't need to understand

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Make me Your vessel
Make me an offering
Make me whatever You want me to be

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I came here with nothing
But all You have given me
Jesus, bring new wine out of me

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
'Cause where there is new wine
There is new power
There is new freedom

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
And the kingdom is here
I lay down my old flames
To carry Your new fire today
